author: Nita Selby
notes: Beckwith drum, 900 tickets, posted the 9th, 342 credits. Receipt says 568 accounts.
Counted the account ids on that run: 242 of them come up more than once, one of them five times.
Beckwith's own list is 970 names and the mail house allowance is 1,200 a month.
Iris asked me for the invited and uninvited rows off the register. Sent them.
